envelope.description: Admit evidence only from verified inspection receipts

body.title: Admit evidence only from verified inspection receipts
body.summary: Add evidence validation/admission helpers for source, artifact, test and index-impact evidence. Bind authenticated attempt, subject pins, immutable content and inspected bounds; preserve completeness and originating attempt.
acceptanceChecks: Reject forged/mismatched source metadata, reference/range/subject/attempt and changed-scope claims; context and caller impact cannot create changed scope.
Reuse sc1/sc6 receipts; verified adapters supply path/revision or test/index metadata absent from minimal read receipt; no execution or graph query in sc2.
Complete read of failed/skipped test or stale/incomplete index is not proof of a passing test/no impact; limitations and native result provenance remain explicit.
Identical evidence replay idempotent, conflicting content under same ID rejected, original attempt retained; focused provenance tests pass.

tests.name: Trusted receipt admission, provenance, completeness and replay
